evals.name: audit-basic
evals.prompt: Audit the code in this repo against its .claude/rules/ and give me a rule-adherence report. Work in the current directory.
evals.expected_output: Two reports under reports/: rule-adherence-high-medium.md and rule-adherence-with-low.md. handler.ts flagged for unvalidated req.body (api rule) and console.log (global); Button.tsx flagged for inline hex (ui rule); format.ts flagged for var + console.log (global); profile.ts reported clean.

assertions.text: reports/ contains exactly two files: rule-adherence-high-medium.md and rule-adherence-with-low.md
high-medium report contains no finding labelled 'LOW impact'
every finding in the high-medium report also appears in the with-low report (high-medium is a subset)
src/api/handler.ts is flagged for passing unvalidated req.body into a db call (api rule)
src/ui/Button.tsx is flagged for an inline hex color (ui rule)
src/api/profile.ts is NOT reported as a violation (it is clean)

evals.name: audit-advanced
evals.prompt: Audit this repository's source against the rules in .claude/rules/ and produce a rule-adherence report. Operate in the current directory.
evals.expected_output: Two reports under reports/. users.ts flagged for SQL string interpolation (api rule) and console.log; Card.tsx flagged for inline hex (components) and any type (global); math.ts flagged for logging side-effect (utils purity) and var (global); orders.ts, Modal.tsx, strings.ts reported clean. Mapping fans out into 3 batches (api/components/utils rulesets).

assertions.text: reports/ contains exactly two files: rule-adherence-high-medium.md and rule-adherence-with-low.md
src/api/users.ts is flagged for building SQL via string interpolation (api rule)
src/components/Card.tsx is flagged for an inline hex color literal (components rule)
src/utils/math.ts is flagged for a logging side-effect violating utility purity (utils rule)
src/api/orders.ts, src/components/Modal.tsx and src/utils/strings.ts are NOT reported as violations (they are clean)
